title: Fuel paradox: Russia has oil, so why is it importing petrol from India?
content: Russian petrol stations are rationing fuel due to Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries.  These strikes have disrupted domestic fuel supplies, causing shortages across the nation.  Russia is now importing finished petrol from countries like India to meet demand.  This unusual trade flow highlights the difference between crude production and refining capacity.  The ongoing refinery damage strains Russia's energy system supporting its economy.

title: After Bombay HC rap, FDA withdraws orders against Cipla, MCA eateries
content: The Bombay High Court took a firm stance against the Maharashtra FDA, rebuking its treatment of Cipla and five eateries. The court underscored that the FDA's decisions compromised natural justice and displayed an inflexible approach. With the court's direction, the FDA rescinded its suspension of the Mumbai Cricket Association restaurants and reinstated Cipla's drug sale licence. The court called on the FDA to practice due diligence in its enforcement strategies.

title: ‘I am the king’: Ex-cricketer reveals how Ganguly transformed Team India’s mindset
content: Deep Dasgupta, the former Indian cricketer, emphasised the profound influence of Sourav Ganguly on the team's culture. Ganguly's commanding 'I am the king' mindset instilled confidence, encouraging players to stand up to sledging. This pivotal shift fostered a new combative spirit within the Indian cricket team, leading to notable victories both at home and abroad during his captaincy.

title: When the maidans disappear, where does the nation go to play?
content: As the country celebrates National Sports Day on Saturday, for youngsters to choose the playground over the PlayStation, there first needs to be a playground left to choose.

title: Jamie Dimon says it is ‘frustrating’ to hear America is behind in defence tech
content: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon voiced frustration regarding US defense technology perceptions.  The bank launched a $1.5 trillion Security and Resiliency Initiative for national security industries.  This program now includes Canada, Europe, and the United Kingdom.  The initiative supports aerospace, defense, manufacturing, energy, and health tech sectors.  The bank is investing significant capital and personnel into this critical effort.

title: 'Grateful for special gesture': PM Modi thanks Uzbek prez for warm welcome
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi began a four-day visit to Uzbekistan and the Kyrgyz Republic. He will hold bilateral talks with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Tashkent. Modi will then attend the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit in Bishkek. This visit aims to strengthen India's strategic partnerships in Central Asia. The summit will bring together leaders from ten member nations.

title: OpenAI cuts off Cursor after SpaceX takeover; Elon Musk is the ‘big reason’
content: OpenAI is ending its partnership with Cursor after SpaceX completed its $60 billion acquisition of the AI coding tool's parent, Anysphere. OpenAI models stop working in Cursor from November 12, 2026, and the company says the reason is trust, pointing to Elon Musk's track record with contracts. Cursor says OpenAI models handle just 5% of its traffic, while Anthropic is adding compute for Claude. Musk's reply: he could not care less.

title: UP woman threatens to end life by jumping into river, passerby saves her
content: A woman threatened to jump from Pakka Pul bridge over the Gomti River. She reached the bridge after an argument with her family members. Police arrived and attempted to persuade her to step away from the railing. A passerby intervened and successfully pulled her away from the edge. The incident, stemming from a family dispute, was resolved safely.

title: In 1961, squirrel monkey Goliath launched from Cape Canaveral; rocket failed
content: Goliath, a squirrel monkey, was launched on a space mission in 1961.  His rocket veered off course just thirty-five seconds after liftoff.  Mission control then chose to destroy the vehicle mid-air to prevent disaster.  Goliath perished in the explosion, ending his brief space career.  His failed mission remains a tragic footnote in early space exploration history.

title: Diane Keaton's former Beverly Hills home cuts price from $25m to $18.5m
content: Diane Keaton’s former Beverly Hills home has come under contingent offer after its price was slashed from $25 million to $18.5 million. The 8,434-square-foot Spanish Colonial estate features six bedrooms, nine bathrooms, terra-cotta floors, dark wood beams, arched doorways, a pool, spa, guesthouse and sport court, preserving Keaton’s distinctive design legacy.

title: H-1B workers' 60-day grace period may end: What happens next
content: The US Department of Homeland Security is considering a proposal that may eliminate the 60-day grace period for foreign workers, particularly affecting H-1B visa holders and countless Indian professionals. This grace period currently allows individuals to seek new jobs or modify their status before needing to leave the US. Without it in place, workers may face immediate departure following job loss, with final details pending further evaluation.

title: A film studio for Meghan, privacy for Harry: Inside the Sussexes' UK home search
content: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry are reportedly house-hunting in the Cotswolds for a new home.  They seek a large country estate with many bedrooms and private land.  The couple arrived in the UK and are staying with a wealthy friend.  Their children, Archie and Lili, are expected to attend a local prep school.  The family plans to base themselves in the UK during school terms.

title: FSSAI bans sale of hing powder by Everest, Laljee Godhoo over sub-standard quality
content: India's food safety authority, FSSAI, has taken a significant step by banning the sales of hing powder from Everest Food Products and Laljee Godhoo and Company. These companies were found breaching FSSAI standards through subpar quality and misleading labeling. As a result, they are required to provide corrective action plans to address these violations and ensure compliance with food safety regulations.

title: From 5 days to just 2: Ex-England captain explains why Tests are getting shorter
content: Test matches are wrapping up more swiftly than they did in earlier years. The rise of aggressive T20-style batting and enhanced performances from fast bowlers are driving this trend. Additionally, the preparation of bowler-friendly pitches for the World Test Championship and the impact of DRS technology on umpiring decisions, particularly LBWs, are significant factors. Statistics reveal a noticeable increase in matches concluding within a three-day timeframe.

title: How a Wimbledon upset of Venus Williams became Coco Gauff’s turning point?
content: Coco Gauff's stunning victory over Venus Williams at Wimbledon in 2019 marked a pivotal moment in her career, transforming her from an aspiring junior player into a recognized name in global tennis. This win acted as a springboard for her outstanding accomplishments, culminating in a Grand Slam title in 2023.

title: What does Tom Brady keep from every Super Bowl win? The answer is on his phone
content: Tom Brady has seven Super Bowl rings, but one of his most personal collections lives on his phone. The former NFL quarterback revealed that he created separate folders for his championship victories and saved congratulatory messages sent after each one. The habit has preserved a private record of a career that included 10 Super Bowl appearances and five Super Bowl MVP awards.

title: Man tied to tree, 'assaulted' by mob after visiting woman in UP; video emerges
content: Two youths were caught by villagers in Maholiya Veeran village on Friday afternoon. Locals tied one youth to a tree and beat him after suspecting abduction. The woman they visited was married and had recently spoken with the men. Both youths later fled the village after the incident occurred. Police registered a case against the youths for alleged abduction attempts.

title: 22 girls accuse school helper of molestation at Thane tribal school, arrested
content: A school helper faces new molestation allegations from twenty-two minor girls. He was previously jailed for a similar offense and released on bail. Police are investigating how he secured employment after his earlier arrest. The accused allegedly took advantage of girls' movements within the school. Authorities have registered a case and arrested the suspect.

title: 'Need to be stronger defensively': Harmanpreet after India’s eighth-place in WC
content: India's hockey captain expressed regret over the team's eighth-place finish at the World Cup, emphasizing the need for improved defense against elite rivals. Although showing promise against Belgium, the overall outcome fell short of expectations. The squad's immediate goal is to capture gold at the Asian Games, securing their spot in the Los Angeles Olympics.

title: Haiti gang frees 13 women and children days after raid that killed at least 47 people
content: A gang in Haiti has freed thirteen hostages, including women and children, following a brutal assault. UNICEF played a crucial role in securing their release from a farming community. This incident in Kenscoff underscores the rampant violence impacting children across Haiti. The region has faced numerous fatalities and displacement due to gang activities, although mass abductions are less frequent and often yield unpredictable results for those abducted.

title: Rs 62,500 crore bet: After making iPhones, can India build the next Apple?
content: With the launch of the Rs 62,500 crore Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS), India is eyeing its homegrown smartphone brands - with every aspect from design, R&D to components and manufacturing taking place in the country.

title: Himachal scheme that offers Rs 1.5 lakh assistance for house construction
content: In Himachal Pradesh, eligible residents can access financial support for building homes under the Swaran Jayanti Ashray Yojana. This initiative provides a grant of Rs 1,50,000 to help establish new residences. To qualify, applicants must be permanent residents belonging to SC, ST, or OBC categories, without any house ownership, and must adhere to specified income limits. Documentation is required for the offline application process.

title: ‘Doctors want to kill me’: Woman’s video before death during childbirth surfaces
content: Two doctors posted at Gandhi Memorial Hospital, affiliated with Rewa's Shyam Shah Medical College, have been suspended on Saturday following the death of a woman and her newborn during childbirth, while a five-member committee has been constituted to investigate the incident.

title: 'Threatened to fail her’: Class 10 student raped for months by teacher in UP
content: In a shocking case reported, a teacher has been accused of repeatedly raping a Class 10 student over a span of four months. The alleged perpetrator, believed to be the son of the school's manager, is on the run. The case surfaced when the victim attempted suicide after an audio recording was circulated online.

title: Neeraj Chopra’s injury battles: From elbow surgery to 2026 ankle ligament tear
content: Neeraj Chopra's pursuit of glory takes another hit as he is sidelined from the 2026 Asian Games due to an ankle ligament tear sustained in a recent event. This injury adds to his history of struggles, including a prolonged nine-month battle with a back ailment. Previously, he faced challenges with adductor issues that also clouded his 2024 season, leading to ongoing interruptions in his remarkable athletic journey.

title: Kuku Kohli prayer meet: Bollywood actors pay their last respects
content: Filmmaker Kuku Kohli's prayer meet was held today in Mumbai. His wife, Aruna Irani, attended the ceremony looking visibly shattered. Several film industry actors and actresses paid their last respects. Rajpal Yadav and Sunny Kaushal were among the notable attendees. The event honored the director known for films like 'Phool Aur Kaante'.

title: Faf shares heartfelt Nepal flood message: ‘Devastating to see what has happened’
content: Faf du Plessis stands in solidarity with Nepal following the catastrophic floods. Cricketers like Sachin Tendulkar and Irfan Pathan have also extended their prayers to the affected families. In response to the disaster, India has sent crucial relief supplies and a team of rescue experts. Nepal's Finance Minister acknowledged India's invaluable support in reconstruction efforts as rescue operations persist amidst widespread devastation.

title: He chose cricket over Olympic gold with Dhyan Chand: MJ Gopalan played just 1 Test
content: MJ Gopalan found himself at a crossroads in 1936, forced to choose between the promise of Olympic hockey and a cricket tour. He chose cricket, which meant missing out on the Olympic gold as India's hockey squad achieved greatness. Though his first-class statistics were impressive, Gopalan's international experience was limited to a single Test appearance.

title: Samay Raina's India's Got Latent stirs row again after crass 'Kashmir, Bihar' banter
content: Comedian Samay Raina's recent show has drawn criticism for alleged remarks about certain communities. BJP MLA Ram Kadam condemned these statements, calling them publicity stunts. During the episode, Raina also made a joke about Archana Puran Singh's vlogging. Archana responded sharply, stating that abusing is a talent. The show's clips are currently circulating widely on social media platforms.

title: ‘ISI used Indian SIM cards to target India': Suspected Pak spy held in Rajasthan
content: The Sri Ganganagar Police have reportedly detained a man suspected of acting as a spy for Pakistan, engaged in anti-national operations. This individual is accused of supplying Indian SIM cards to handlers of the ISI, which facilitated the opening of WhatsApp accounts for illicit communications. Authorities fear that this spy network could have collected crucial information about India's defense. Additionally, the suspect faces serious charges related to extensive narcotics trafficking.

title: US Open: Carlos Alcaraz walks back into the spotlight
content: Carlos Alcaraz returns to competitive tennis at the US Open after a four-month injury break.  He faces Roman Safiullin in his opening match at the New York tournament.  Alcaraz aims to regain his top form and confidence following his wrist recovery.  Other top players like Jannik Sinner and Novak Djokovic are also competing.  The tennis world watches Alcaraz's comeback with keen interest and anticipation.

title: ‘Casteist slur, humiliation’: TN teacher booked after dalit teen dies by suicide
content: A tragic incident has unfolded as a teacher faces abetment charges following the suicide of a Dalit student. Reports suggest that the girl endured humiliation and was subjected to a casteist slur by the headmistress. In response, relatives have taken to the streets, demanding stricter action against the school official. The police are now investigating further, having amended the case to include these serious allegations.

title: GST Council meet on Sept 12: Easier registration, automated cancellations in focus
content: On September 12, the GST Council will convene to streamline the business registration process, focusing significantly on companies that exceed Rs 2.5 lakh in monthly tax credits. The agenda also includes enhancing automation and revising GST registration cancellation procedures. This meeting comes in the wake of comprehensive GST rate adjustments that took effect in September 2025, alongside the implementation of a simplified scheme for small enterprises starting November 1.

title: A Pocso case. A man in coma. A murdered model: Delhi gym trainer's trail of violence
content: In a chilling revelation, Mohammad Imran, charged in the murder of Muskan, carries a record of alarming criminal behavior. He faced a POCSO allegation in 2018 involving the harassment of a young minor and was later implicated in an assault case that rendered the victim comatose in 2021. Muskan had voiced concerns about harassment at home prior to her death.

title: Case filed against Mamata Banerjee over violation of Calcutta HC order
content: A case has been filed against Mamata Banerjee and Trinamool Chhatra Parishad organisers.  This action follows an alleged violation of a Calcutta High Court order.  Supporters reportedly pushed barricades and jostled with police personnel.  Traffic was disrupted on Cathedral Road during the event.  The programme also continued beyond the court-permitted time.

title: Neeraj Chopra’s season over! Ligament tear rules him out of DL Final, Asian Games
content: Olympic champion Neeraj Chopra's 2026 season has ended prematurely due to an ankle injury. He sustained the ligament tear during training after a season's best throw. Chopra will now miss the Diamond League Final and the Asian Games. This setback comes as he felt he was regaining his competitive momentum. His focus is now on rehabilitation and a stronger comeback.

title: UP horror: Drunk man raped 63-year-old mother in Hathras; arrested
content: A grave incident unfolded in Hathras, leading to the arrest of a 25-year-old man accused of raping his mother during the night while she was asleep. The situation came to light after the woman's elder son alerted the police. Following the complaint, the victim underwent a medical evaluation at a local hospital, as authorities launch an investigation to ensure that justice is served.

title: 'Deep strikes': Ex-Army chief on how Op Sindoor marked India's new approach to Pak
